description: I'm not sure why it hasn't occurred to me until now to post my answers to these candidate surveys, but I was really quite impressed with this one from Prosperity Indiana. The questions really made me think, and a lot of the things they asked about were relevant to a broad spectrum of my proposals.…
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Joshua Brant
title: Prosperity Indiana Candidate Survey – Elect Joshua Brant
